personalInfo.summary: Design Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with expertise bridging high-polish UI design and robust software architecture using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Experienced building bespoke, accessible web applications with modern design systems (Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion, Lenis) alongside scalable backend APIs and database schemas (Prisma, Supabase, Docker). Proven track record delivering high-velocity event platforms, e-commerce portals, and national registration systems serving tens of thousands of users.

experiences.company: Society of Renewable Energy ITS Branch
bullets: Directed a cross-functional engineering team of 11 developers delivering the official web platform (sre-its.com) and digital assets for organizational recruitment.
Engineered multi-step registration funnels with dynamic REST API integrations and robust client/server form validation, ensuring high-conversion onboarding.
Established automated CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions, Husky pre-push hooks, and lint-staged, maintaining zero-regression code quality and high release velocity.
Spearheaded frontend engineering for Petrolida 2025's official web portal, crafting bespoke micro-interactions and kinetic smooth scrolling with Lenis and Framer Motion.
Architected a modular design system using Radix UI primitives and Tailwind CSS with strict tokenization, ensuring responsive parity across mobile and desktop viewports.
Engineered an interactive merchandise and ticketing e-commerce system with client-side Zustand state persistence and TanStack Query data synchronization.
Engineered high-traffic participant registration platforms for ITS's largest annual orientation outreach (serving thousands of prospective university applicants).
Built complex, accessible multi-step intake funnels (Open Campus & WSN) with dynamic form controllers using React Hook Form, Zod schema validation, and Biome linting.
Implemented role-based client routing guards with Higher-Order Components (HOC withAuth) and centralized authentication session state via Zustand.
Engineered scalable web applications serving 20,000+ university students using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, achieving sub-second page loads and optimal Core Web Vitals.
Translated complex Figma designs into modular, accessible, and responsive component libraries adhering to modern design system specifications.
Collaborated closely in agile sprint cycles with designers and engineers, conducting peer code reviews and driving consistent UX polish across all public pages.
Designed modular RESTful backend services and relational database schemas supporting internal organizational management systems.
Authored and mentored the 'IT Junior Preps' web development curriculum covering modern React, TypeScript, and API architecture in partnership with Hacktiv8.
